description: Waymo rider-only mileage milestones from sources OTHER than the Safety Impact Data Hub's quarterly CSV1 files, compiled by Anders Eidesvik (corrected Oct 2026). The pipeline merges these with every hosted CSV1 release (data/static/miles_quarterly.json) into the site's mileage chart, so hub figures are not repeated here.
methodology: Waymo does not publish a historical time series of cumulative miles. Each point is dated to the period it covers when the source says so (e.g. 'through the end of June'); real-time milestone announcements are dated to the announcement day. Figures published without an as-of date are excluded, since Waymo announcements sometimes cite totals that lag by months. October 2026 corrections: 7.13M→7.14M and redated to its Oct 2023 data cutoff; 22M redated from the announcement-adjacent 2024-06-05 to its 'end of June' cutoff; Wayback-Machine readings of the hub (33M, 50M, 71.43M) and the undated 127M press figure were replaced by the exact CSV1 values the pipeline now downloads.
